'''2009 Worlds Day 2 John Anderson LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]
* '''Username:''' Puck71
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
